# Daily Briefing – Tuesday, 30 June

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training session logged and just 4,042 steps, which is fairly low activity overall. The silver lining is your body burned 2,302 kcal, virtually matching your 2,300 target, so energy balance stayed on track. The main flag is sleep at 6.3 hours — that's below where you want to be heading into race prep.

Recovery markers are actually encouraging despite the rest day. HRV at 105ms sits comfortably within your 102–120ms baseline, and a resting HR of 44 bpm is excellent. Stress at 20/100 suggests you're relaxed and physiologically ready — go ahead with today's planned session as normal, your body is primed.

With 45 days to Chester, prioritise hitting your 175g protein today — especially since yesterday was sedentary, it supports muscle maintenance. And aim for 7.5+ hours tonight; that sleep deficit will matter more as training intensity builds.
